name: RealBrowser MCP Gateway
description: Lets a local daemon on this computer ask this browser to load a page or file and hand back what it shows, for AI agents that read the web. Reads only; no clicking or typing. Runs in its own cookie container and window.
content_security_policy: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ws://127.0.0.1:*; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'
